_note: How a team run's budget is split (BudgetPolicy in core/team/config.py, which documents each field). All values are placeholders, not measured, to be tuned on the dev incidents. Shares are decimal strings. director_share stays free in the run for the director's diagnosis and its one repair; auditor_share is the auditor's allocation; the rest goes to the blocks in proportion to their estimated work; a manager keeps manager_share of its block and the rest is its operators' pool. operator_task_limit_reservations bounds what one task may spend: that many times its first reservation (an initial attempt, two repairs, one reassignment).
